text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hahh, hahh... Good job today, young miss, 
peace and luvvvv!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Good work. ......

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, fr, wasn't today's festival totally 
high vibe, ok-dokey, super happy!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It was like... yeah! Zephyr-chi was, like, 
all WHOOSH! And then, like, ROOOAAAR!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Seriously, that was sooo much fuuun~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ......What a troublesome person.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... —

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Sweeping up everything, becoming the 
wind—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Today, it is accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yet I can still... become it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us polish it further. Even sharper, 
stronger, and fiercer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Until reaching the "promised" Autumn 
Shield—

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Fans
text_block_list.text: Zephyr!! Yamanin Zephyeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"That was a suuuuper amazing run today 
too!! It really got my heart pumping!!"

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Show us your wind, your soul next time 
tooーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, a banner... "Zephyr Spirit", it 
says.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Fufufu... ...Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(It feels so good! Even though I'm 
completely exhausted... it's like a 
blessed breeze, pushing my back and making 
my body feel so light!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I shall swallow and sweep even that up... 
...and become an even greater wind.
With the race and the Winning Live over—

In the Kyoto Racecourse grandstand, where 
the crowd had departed and night had 
quietly fallen, Yamanin Zephyr came to a 
sudden stop.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...To me, this land is the place where the 
wind was born.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Everything started here. When I met that 
wind I so admired— and the "Emperor of the 
Mile"—everything began.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to set our next goal as the 
Yasuda Kinen, please.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No... my only aim is 1st place. Winning 
the Yasuda Kinen, that is.
choice_data_list: ...I see. In that case, it's finally time—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let us begin from here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's train even harder by the time the 
summer storms swirl!
